reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 1 points better, in a game of about 218 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 53 times in 100; most games like this end between 191 and 239 total points.
